covered.label: Luas Red Line
covered.detail: 32 stops, two southwestern branches (Tallaght, Saggart) sharing one common trunk east to The Point.

covered.label: Luas Green Line
covered.detail: 35 stops, Broombridge to Brides Glen, including a one-way city-centre loop (Parnell to Trinity).

notCovered.label: DART / Iarnród Éireann commuter rail
notCovered.detail: Not covered - out of v1 scope, a future addition.

notCovered.label: Dublin Bus, Bus Éireann, Go-Ahead Ireland
notCovered.detail: Not covered - these are buses, not trains.

notes: Live running times only, confirmed by the NTA GTFS-RT v2 TripUpdates feed - a trip without realtime confirmation is dropped, never shown as a schedule-only guess. Abbey Street is the Red Line hub and never shows a Green chip (about 200 m walk to the Green interchange). The Green Line's Parnell-Trinity city-centre loop is direction-exclusive: O'Connell - GPO and O'Connell Upper are served northbound-only (towards Broombridge), Marlborough is served southbound-only (towards Brides Glen).
